decision.reason: Neither model satisfies the predeclared selection rule: accept the complete draft twice and correctly identify every deliberate omission twice.

notes: Both error-contract omissions identify missing invalid-ID behavior.
Both state-preservation omissions identify missing same-title behavior, but also falsely report missing error rules.
Neither missing-tests review identifies the omitted test requirements; blocked verdicts alone overstate useful detection.
Both complete drafts are rejected for rules already present or invented ambiguity.
The missing-tests draft is explicitly praised for test requirements that are absent from that draft but present in the original task.

interpretation: This sample suggests reviewers do not reliably distinguish original task requirements from coverage in the delivered document. It does not prove the cause or establish general model quality. Neither model is suitable for selection on these results.
next_recommendation: Add an explicit requirement-to-document coverage review with exact document field references and quotations, validating that cited text exists. Keep original-task evidence separate from delivered-document evidence. Re-run this same positive/negative set before selecting a reviewer or starting another lifecycle trial; valid citations alone still do not prove semantic coverage.
